egress.terms: Per-prediction output files are served from Replicate's CDN, but only for the retention window.

record.chaining: No viable chain: 100 MB per object x 1-hour retention. This is the textbook 'big per-file cap lives where retention is shortest' inverse. Here small cap AND short retention.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 100 MB via the client library ('This will work for files up to 100MB'); data-URI path recommended only <1 MB. Retention is the killer: 'For predictions created through the API, all input parameters, output values, output files, and logs are automatically removed after an hour, by default.' Files API objects carry an explicit `expires_at`.
record.reliability_note: Container registry r8.im requires authentication. Anonymous requests to `/v2/` return HTTP 401 and manifest queries redirect to account login pages.
